title: Build a recoverable task vertical slice
description: M1 after M0. Ship flat-task capture, list/detail, edit, complete, reopen, cancel, activity, and the standalone CLI through the shared TypeScript command path. Add one optional workspace-wide @category and any number of #tags parsed from plain task text into derived metadata, with a compact muted footer in dense task rows. Include optimistic concurrency, idempotency receipts, read-only and dry-run behavior, backups, versioned JSON export/restore, and file-backed SQLite failure-path tests. Demonstrate UI/CLI changes survive restart and restore.
